entities.name: UniProt C5CPN2 transaldolase
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Variovorax paradoxus S110 transaldolase; EC 2.2.1.2.
Catalyzes the reversible transfer of a three-carbon unit between sedoheptulose 7-phosphate and glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate in the non-oxidative pentose phosphate pathway.

entities.name: Nonoxidative pentose phosphate pathway
observations: Transaldolase participates in the non-oxidative branch, interconverting sugar phosphates and helping balance pentose-phosphate-pathway metabolites.
